benchmark_isolation.description: repository-owned disposable Agent Memory SQLite state keyed by unique Gauntlet run namespace

checkpoint.notes: the public AgentMemory facade does not expose checkpoint creation; private runtime access is deliberately not used by this adapter

correct.notes: the public correction path requires qualified evidence or attestation that the current neutral Gauntlet operation contract cannot yet carry without Agent Memory-specific semantics

deterministic_recovery.notes: claimed for the frozen single-host SQLite profile and tested by repeated public reopen/observation

durable_correction.notes: not qualified in this contestant configuration until a neutral evidence-bearing correction contract exists; refusal is preserved rather than bypassing PAMA

durable_deletion.notes: public governed pruning followed by AgentMemory.open() recovery/non-resurrection check

recall.notes: public AgentMemory.recall() under the requested benchmark scope

recover.notes: neutral recover operation maps directly to supported AgentMemory.open() create-or-recover behavior

remember.notes: public AgentMemory.remember() under the requested benchmark scope

reset.notes: adapter teardown of disposable benchmark state; not a native Agent Memory operation

restart_recovery.notes: native persisted-state recovery through public AgentMemory.open()

scope_isolation.notes: exercised through the public facade over one scope_distinct_v1 store per namespace: project-bound keys and canonical governed admission

metadata.baseline_status: unaccepted transition candidate (docs/67 Step A); not a published baseline

supersedes.reason: v1 drives several projects through one tenant-wide store, which #786 store profiles refuse

runtime_pin_history.reason: the protected runtime changed (#786 store-open contract version separation); the pin names the runtime under test
